notes: «فأتيت البراء بن عازب فسألته فقال» : the one asked and answering is a link (rule 5, example 5); Bara's answer carries the Prophet's ruling.
«فأتيته فسألته فقال مثل ذلك» : Zayd b. Arqam answers with the same saying, so a second route (rule 4), written in full; shared_tail stays null because the two routes repeat the head.
«شريك لي» and «قال قد بعته في السوق» are the partner in the scene, not links.
